collections.title: ArduPilot tinkering
collections.heading: Questions, simulations, and what I learned.
intro: I started with questions about flying my paraglider better. The turn-tracking work led me into Plane trajectory planning; the pitch oscillations led me back to the physics between the canopy and payload.
I worked with Codex to implement ideas, run comparisons and investigate failures. These pages tell the story of that work, including the results that changed my mind and the questions still open.

pages.title: Can relative pitch unlock better longitudinal control?
pages.description: Truth-state feedback, observability and the free-body equations.

collections.note: These simulations do not establish flight readiness. Raw logs and built binaries are omitted from the archive. Experimental longitudinal controllers and the proposed observer are research, not deployed features.
